record.title: Chief AI Officer Guides (Chief AI Officer Guidebook; Practical Manual for Establishing a Chief AI Officer and Implementing AI Governance)
record.summary: Two J-AISI documents giving private businesses standard practical guidance for appointing and running a Chief AI Officer (CAIO), to balance value creation from AI with responsible use (risk reduction and regulatory compliance): the Chief AI Officer Guidebook, for the CAIO and whoever appoints one, and the Practical Manual for Establishing a Chief AI Officer and Implementing AI Governance, for CAIO staff, executives and legal, compliance, IT, data and HR functions. They cover organisational design, AI risk management structures, assessment and escalation of high-risk cases, authority to halt deployment, incident response, oversight, talent and procurement across the AI lifecycle.
record.notes: Both documents are version 1.00, dated 1 Mar 2026 on their covers and issued by the J-AISI secretariat; J-AISI's list of Framework outputs dates their release 17 Mar 2026, and drafts of both were posted on 5 Feb 2026. The guidebook states that it has no legally binding force and is to be revised as a living document. It notes that Japan's national administrative organs must establish a CAIO under the guideline adopted pursuant to Article 13 of the AI Act and under the Digital Agency's guideline on the procurement and use of generative AI in government, and points to ISO/IEC 42001 certification as an option. J-AISI publishes both documents in Japanese and in English.

verification.note: Stored: J-AISI's bilingual release page on aisi.go.jp; the Japanese originals of the Chief AI Officer Guidebook (15 pages) and of the Practical Manual (78 pages), both version 1.00 dated 2026年3月1日 and issued by the AISI secretariat (AI セーフティ・インスティテュート (AISI) 事務局); J-AISI's English versions, headed 'Please refer to the original text for accuracy'; and J-AISI's lists of Framework and Information outputs. They confirm the title, the issuer, the document date of 1 March 2026, the release on 17 March 2026, the drafts of 5 February 2026, the non-binding character and the content; the summary is checked against the Japanese texts. date_published follows the date on the documents; the release date is in notes.

judgment.status_reasoning: Version 1.00 of both documents was released on 17 March 2026 and is listed as current on J-AISI's Framework list; non-binding ('法的拘束力を有するものではない').
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI safety institute's guidance on organisational AI governance and risk management (high-risk escalation, authority to halt deployment, incident response): in scope with no note, although it also covers value creation.
judgment.date_reasoning: The Japanese and English covers of both documents are dated 1 March 2026 (2026 年 3 月 1 日); J-AISI's Framework list dates the release 17 March 2026. Following the rule to take a guideline's date from the document itself, date_published is 2026-03-01 and the release date is in notes.

open_questions: A checker may prefer the release date (17 March 2026, J-AISI Framework list) to the document date (1 March 2026) for date_published.
